data.narrative:
Solinftec is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies: Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C), alongside one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, using the $40M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression, yields $76M. The peer-median method anchors to the four-company median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.8B. These methods produce materially different results, reflecting the wide dispersion in how early-stage robotics companies are currently valued in the market.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $65M to $1.9B, with a median of $850M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects meaningful uncertainty around whether Solinftec's capital efficiency and market position align with the higher-valued Series B cohort or require a more conservative stage-based discount. Key uncertainties include relative revenue traction, unit economics, and whether recent peer valuations reflect sustainable market conditions or froth in the robotics sector.
